title: Adapter secrets plaintext
description: The plaintext an adapter's secrets are sealed as, both in the upload (adapter-secrets.schema.json) and in the answer that delivers them back (adapter-secrets-answer.schema.json): compact JSON in UTF-8. Each name appears once, and each value is 1 to 16384 bytes of UTF-8 without a NUL; the schema states that limit only as 16384 characters, since a schema counts characters. Whoever opens a plaintext refuses one that breaks this schema or either rule. A member this schema does not define is refused.

secrets.description: The secrets, at most 16, each name once; none when the adapter stores no secret.

value.description: The value, 1 to 16384 bytes of UTF-8 without a NUL.
